subject_session: 000986: 15 sessions / 5 mice (example sub-LA9 ses-1); 001262: 400 gerbil auditory-nerve fibres

headline_stat.name: cortical units frequency-tuned (perm p<0.01) / 5-way decoding accuracy

stated_limitation: Cortical best frequency here is an **iso-level** preference measured at a single level (60 dB SPL), so it mixes the unit's tuning with the mouse's audiogram. It is not the same quantity as the characteristic frequency of an auditory-nerve fibre, which is defined at threshold... **We do not claim that cortical tuning is broader than peripheral tuning**, even though that is the textbook expectation. Both width estimates are biased downwards by their own measurement limits

justification.dataset: Both dandisets are canonical for frequency tuning (000986 is a listed known-good cortex set; 001262 single auditory-nerve fibres is the classic peripheral demonstration), covering two stages of the pathway.
justification.handling: Real streamed data with correct ragged-column parsing, PSTH-derived epoch windows, quality/rate filtering, NaN cleaning, and a documented rejection of 001419 for integer-rounded spike times.
justification.analysis: Permutation tests for frequency selectivity, Wilcoxon for responsiveness, cross-validated Bayesian decoding with a shuffled-label control, Q10/bandwidth via interpolation, and a NeMoS Poisson GLM, all appropriate and controlled.
justification.correctness: Every headline number (59 fibres, Q10 median 3.14 n=21, 375 selective, 0.58-octave median width, 1230/1426 tuned, decoding 0.808/0.196) reproduces from the committed batch logs and is internally consistent and physically possible.
justification.figures: Figures are clearly labeled with units and sample sizes, show the effect (V-shaped threshold curves, diagonal tuning band, confusion matrix), mark resolution limits, and use representative rather than flattering example units spanning the BF and selectivity range.
justification.honesty: The caveats section is exemplary: it declines the textbook cortex-vs-nerve breadth claim, flags iso-level vs threshold-CF confound, onset-transient contamination at 2 kHz, and smoothing/measurement biases, with claims proportionate to the evidence.
justification.verdict: A careful, well-controlled, honestly qualified two-stage demonstration whose numbers fully reproduce; I would accept this and move on.
